title: An agency leaves Medicare, and a new name enrols at the same suite
question: Where a hospice or home-health agency left the Medicare files, did a differently named agency enrol at the same suite, and do the owner numbers tie the two?
finding: Between April 2023 and October 2026, 1,481 California hospice enrolments and 555 home-health enrolments left the Medicare files. At 21 suites a differently named agency of the same kind first appeared in the files after the one that left (21 pairs). 0 of the pairs follow an agency on the federal revoked list; 7 pairs share a federal owner or manager number; 0 do both. 2 pairs are in the six Bay Area counties: Seva Homecare, LLC. (last in the 2023-04 file; not on the revoked list) then Mission Home Health Of East Bay LLC (from 2023-07) at 5976 W Las Positas Blvd Ste 118, Pleasanton; no owner or manager number in common; Dc Giron Healthcare Services Inc (last in the 2024-01 file; not on the revoked list) then 1Health Home Health Inc (from 2026-07) at 3170 Crow Canyon Pl Ste 130, San Ramon; no owner or manager number in common. No revoked agency is followed at its suite by a new agency sharing an owner or manager number.
how: The 15 quarterly federal enrolment files (April 2023 to October 2026) give each enrolment an address. An agency "left" when it is absent from the October 2026 file. A pair is an agency that left and a different enrolment number with a different legal name, of the same kind, at the same street address, suite and ZIP code, that first appears in a later file than the first agency did and no earlier than one quarter before its last. The two are then compared on every federal owner, officer and manager number either ever carried (exact identifiers), on the federal revoked list, and on Medicare payments. Bay Area pairs come first. The State licence listing could not be used for this: it prints street addresses without suites.
limits: Agencies rent small suites in the same office buildings, so one following another is common and usually means only that a tenant changed. A new enrolment number with the same people can be an ordinary sale, a merger of two enrolments, or a move from branch to parent, each of which Medicare records in this way. The federal freeze on new hospice and home-health enrolments began on 13 May 2026, so few new names can appear after that. Owner files begin in April 2023.
